notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
